maya: Hi all 2- first week questions. A contractor gave me an invoice I paid and need to expense it. Is there a specific contractor reimbursement flow vs normal expenses? Also I want to check if maternity leave policies are in the handbook (planning ahead).

Omar (People Ops): @maya for contractor invoices we typically route through AP not expense. Use the vendor onboarding form: https://redwood.example.com/ap/vendor-onboard and cc ap@redwood.example.com. If you paid personally we can issue a reimbursement but we need the vendor to be in our system. If you need help getting a vendor created, DM me the contractor name and W9.

BenefitsBot: BenefitsBot: Parental leave policy is in the employee handbook under "Time Off". Here's the quick link: https://redwood.example.com/hr/handbook#parental-leave (automated)

maya: thanks. For vendor onboarding is there a timeline? I booked contractor for last week and paid them with Venmo. I have receipt and Venmo ID.

Omar (People Ops): Vendor onboarding typically takes 5-7 business days after form + W9. For existing contractors we can do an expedited reimbursement via payroll (select `Contractor Reimbursement` and attach proof). It will show on next payroll run as a separate line.

nate: tagging @PayrollBot 2- can payroll process a one-off Venmo reimbursement?

PayrollBot: PayrollBot: Venmo reimbursements are allowed if vendor can't invoice but require proof of payment and vendor confirmation. Payments processed via payroll as ACH to employee unless vendor is created. See policy: https://redwood.example.com/payroll/reimb-policy (automated)

maya: Ok I submitted the vendor form and attached the Venmo receipt. Also following up on PTO accrual rate in handbook 2- do new hires accrue immediately?

Omar (People Ops): PTO accrues from your first day but new hires are subject to a 90-day eligibility period for some benefits (e.g., parental leave full pay). Accrual rate shown in the handbook varies by tenure band. If you want the exact numbers for your band I can pull them.

maya: please do, DM me the accrual table. Thanks y'all :)
